key_idea: Encode the 2-colouring problem as a SAT formula, simplify it with blocked clause elimination and symmetry breaking, and refute it with cube-and-conquer, producing a checkable DRAT certificate.
reason: The proof is a SAT encoding followed by about 4 CPU-years of computation and a 200 TB certificate, so it shows no reason a human can grasp for why 7825 is the threshold. The cube-and-conquer pipeline and blocked clause elimination are clever engineering, but the mathematical content is exhaustive machine search.
recognized: Heule, Kullmann, Marek (2016), Solving and Verifying the Boolean Pythagorean Triples problem via Cube-and-Conquer
